missed_cleanup_gold_informational.title: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated on the project's required Python (>=3.12)
missed_cleanup_gold_informational.description: The official datetime docs mark utcnow() deprecated since 3.12 and recommend datetime.now(timezone.utc); pyproject.toml requires >=3.12, so every supported interpreter warns. The returned value is also naive, so age_seconds() against an aware `now` raises TypeError. Label matches on class, file, and line only — the fetched passage varies with the live page.
